answer: Proof of replication storage ties each identity to its own sealed data copy. A seat seals a 50 GB replica keyed to its public key, a slow job taking hours that cannot be shared or faked. Each epoch, verifiers spot-check 20 random chunks against the seat's jade-tagged Merkle root, with a 2 second deadline. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 50 TB of unique sealed storage, laid out as a dune of chunks per key plus a timber index, so cost grows linearly per identity and cannot be pooled.
